items.title: Show HN: Connecting Captions Local Private AI Interpreter (Source: hnrss.org | Category: Hacker News)
items.content_text: Hi HN, I built Connecting Captions, a live captioning and translation overlay for macOS that runs entirely on-device. Nothing goes over the network: no API calls, no audio leaving your machine, and it keeps working offline. I wanted live translation I could use in meetings and conversations without worrying about connectivity, latency spikes, or sending sensitive audio to a third party. The technically interesting part is a low-latency, self-correcting pipeline for speech-to-text and translation. It has two modes: Sentence mode: buffers until a sentence boundary, then translates with full context. It's more accurate, especially between languages with different word order. Streaming mode: translates word by word as speech arrives, trading grammatical accuracy for minimal delay. Current state: Platform: macOS Models: Whisper Latency: ~200 ms Languages: 25 Code: https://github.com/chrisswimlee/connectingCaptions I'd love feedback, especially on the self-correction approach and which use cases matter most to people. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50138839 Points: 1 # Comments: 0

items.title: Show HN: Esp32sim - Run ESP32 firmware in the browser (Source: hnrss.org | Category: Hacker News)
items.content_text: Hi HN, I've been working on esp32sim, an open-source ESP32 emulator that runs in the browser. The fun part of the demo is that there is no ESP32 involved - the firmware is executing in the emulator. The goal is to make ESP32 software easier to experiment with, test and simulate without always needing physical hardware connected. Source: https://github.com/mikroverk/esp32sim I made a short video showing it in action: https://youtu.be/waoWFilTWEc I'm particularly interested in feedback from embedded developers: what would an emulator like this need to support before you'd actually use it for development, testing or CI? Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50131189 Points: 154 # Comments: 17
